The '''Sylo farm''' was run by the [[Sylo family]] on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

==History==
It was run by the same family for ten generations.<ref name="PS" /> The farm was located in the outbacks of Dantooine, far from galactic events until the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)|Battle of Dantooine]], [[Paxi Sylo]], one of the family's children, ran up a hill near the farm to witness the ongoing fighting.<ref name="CW12" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Sylo farm had been abandoned.<ref name="PS" />
